generator.imagePostprocessing: None. Selected PNGs copied byte-for-byte; no raster editing.

inspectionNotes: Alpha > 128 is used for visible subject bounds because generation contains extremely faint alpha 1 pixels beyond the subject. Liquid coordinate suggestions use normalized full-canvas coordinates and should be adjusted while visually checking the live composition.

assets.generationPrompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: transparent PNG glass overlay for a refined mobile drink mixing app.
Primary request: one EMPTY thin clear short straight-sided tumbler, with absolutely no contents. The full glass is isolated on a genuinely transparent background, and its hollow interior/belly must also be genuinely transparent so animated liquid rendered behind the PNG remains fully visible. Render only the glass edges, delicate rim, slim bottom, and restrained front-surface highlights; not an opaque white or grey silhouette.
Style/medium: exquisitely realistic product photography / physically based 3D, sophisticated quiet editorial mood, like a fine iced latte product shot.
Composition/framing: square 1024x1024 canvas, single glass exactly centered, entire glass visible, approximately 78% canvas height and 68% canvas width, generous clear margins all sides. Upright short cylindrical glass, approximately 9cm diameter and 10cm high, near-parallel straight walls, slight natural taper acceptable. Front view from just slightly above, seeing a narrow elegant elliptical opening, 85mm product lens without wide angle distortion. Baseline around 90% of frame height.
Lighting/mood: broad soft warm-neutral key from upper left, subtle neutral right rim, refined fine white specular edge highlights, photorealistic clear colorless glass, small restrained thickness at the bottom. Transparent center should have only minimal translucent highlights.
Scene/backdrop: actual alpha transparency; no environment, ground, background, checkerboard, floor or backdrop painted into the image.
Constraints: EMPTY glass only; preserve true alpha inside and outside the glass, especially a clear hollow belly. Fine clean cutout edges. No ice, no drink, no water, no milk, no garnish, no coaster, no reflections of a room, no contact shadow, no label, no typography, no logos, no UI, no cartoon, no opaque interior.
assets.refinementPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: true transparent PNG glass highlights overlay for a drink mixing interface.
Input image: the existing EMPTY clear glass is the edit target. Keep its exact glass silhouette, full framing, rim position, size, camera angle, thin base and warm-neutral upper-left lighting.
Change only the glass surface reflections and transparency: make the entire hollow interior, from just under the rim to just above the base, much more smoothly transparent. Eliminate ALL frosted white/grey opaque patches and scratchy/dithered halos. The clear belly should be essentially invisible except for a few very narrow subtle vertical specular lines near the sidewalls. The background must show cleanly through, including behind the top elliptical opening. Keep elegant fine bright rim edges and a believable transparent clear glass base. Crisp smooth edges, realistic thin glass, delicate restrained optics. Do not make a thick white frame. No pixels or stray halos outside the original glass boundary.
Constraints: EMPTY glass with no contents, no liquid, ice, garnish, shadow, background, surface, text or logo. Actual transparent alpha inside and outside the glass; preserve the original composition.
